updates.title: HOW YOU ALREADY HAVE WHAT IT TAKES TO SUCCEED
updates.excerpt: Discover how to leverage your unique strengths for success with Hasan Kubba & Ash Ali in this Talks at Google episode.
updates.content: In this acclaimed Talks at Google session, Ash Ali and Hasan Kubba deconstruct the core principles of their award-winning book 'The Unfair Advantage'. They break down the MILES framework and demonstrate why grit and hard work alone are not enough — understanding your individual strengths, resources, and timing gives you an unfair edge.
updates.author: Ash Ali & Hasan Kubba

updates.title: YOU MIGHT BE OVERLOOKING YOUR UNFAIR ADVANTAGE: HERE'S HOW TO FIND IT
updates.excerpt: Many believe proper education, pedigree, and money are paramount to success. If that is the case, billionaires and icons like Oprah Winfrey never would have made their mark.
updates.content: Society constantly tells us that success comes down to credentials, high test scores, and deep venture pockets. Yet history consistently proves that the most revolutionary leaders broke through by identifying non-linear strengths. Explore how to audit your personal stack.
updates.author: Ash Ali

updates.title: HOW THE SUCCESSFUL LEVERAGE THEIR OPPORTUNITIES AND HOW WE CAN USE OURS
updates.excerpt: Realistically, the authors – Ash Ali and Hasan Kubba advocate for a hybrid 'reality growth mindset.'
updates.content: Optimism without realism is delusion. High performers develop a Reality Growth Mindset: accepting the raw cards they have been dealt, while maintaining unconditional agency to play them with relentless precision.
updates.author: Ash Ali

updates.title: ARE BILLIONAIRES JUST LUCKY? THE TRUTH ABOUT SUCCESS
updates.excerpt: Unpacking the role of serendipity, market timing, and prepared capability in modern startup scaleups.
updates.content: Is success purely meritocratic, or is it fundamentally down to luck? The answer is both. By understanding how luck operates in ecosystems, founders can create larger surface areas for fortune to strike.
updates.author: Ash Ali

faqs.question: How tailored is the session?
faqs.answer: Every workshop is adapted to the organisation, audience and decisions that need to be made. Preparation may include stakeholder interviews, a short pre-session questionnaire or an Uhubs capability diagnostic.

faqs.question: Can the workshop be delivered virtually?
faqs.answer: Yes. Workshops can be delivered in person or virtually, although leadership labs involving complex decisions generally work best in person.

faqs.question: Can a keynote and workshop be combined?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Keynote-to-Action format gives a wider audience the big idea and then takes a smaller leadership group into facilitated application.

faqs.question: How are fees determined?
faqs.answer: Fees depend on the format, preparation, audience, location and level of follow-on support. Share your date, objectives and indicative budget and we will recommend the most suitable option.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Ash Ali ('we', 'us', or 'our') collects, uses, and protects your personal information when you visit ashali.com or interact with our services.
privacyPolicy.content:
## 1. Information We Collect
We collect information that you voluntarily provide to us when you fill out contact forms, book a keynote speech, enquire about executive workshops, subscribe to our newsletter, or request the Global Sales Capability Index. This may include your full name, business email address, company or organisation name, job title, and event requirements.

## 2. How We Use Your Information
We use the information we collect solely to:
- Respond to your inquiries, keynote booking requests, and workshop proposals
- Deliver our research insights, newsletter updates, and articles you have subscribed to
- Provide resources you have requested, including the Global Sales Capability Index dataset
- Improve our website content, user experience, and digital services

## 3. Data Protection and Security
We implement strict technical and organisational measures to ensure your personal data is stored securely and protected against unauthorised access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal data to any third party for marketing or advertising purposes.

## 4. Third-Party Service Providers
We may share limited data with trusted third-party service providers who assist us in operating our website, processing newsletter subscriptions, and delivering analytics. All third-party providers are subject to strict confidentiality and data protection obligations in compliance with applicable privacy regulations.

## 5. Cookies and Privacy
Our website uses essential and privacy-focused performance cookies to ensure proper site navigation and understand how visitors interact with our content. You may configure your browser settings to reject cookies if you prefer.

## 6. Your Rights Under GDPR and UK Data Protection Laws
If you are located in the UK or EEA, you have the right to access, rectify, or request the deletion of your personal data held by us. You may also withdraw your consent to receive communications at any time. To exercise any of these rights, please contact us directly at contact@ashali.com.

## 7. Updates to This Policy
We may periodically update this Privacy Policy to reflect changes in our operational or legal practices. Any updates will be posted directly to this page with an updated revision date.

## 8. Contact Information
If you have any questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy, please email contact@ashali.com.
